parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem: Limewater is a saturated solution of $\text{Ca(OH)}_2$ in water. It is used to test for the presence of $\text{CO}_2$ in a gaseous mixture.
parts.text: Write an equation for the reaction between limewater and $\text{CO}_2$.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.stem: A saturated solution of $\text{Ba(OH)}_2$ can be used instead of $\text{Ca(OH)}_2$ to test for $\text{CO}_2$. A saturated solution of $\text{Mg(OH)}_2$ cannot be used for this test.
parts.text: Explain why a saturated solution of $\text{Ba(OH)}_2$ **can** be used to test for $\text{CO}_2$.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: Explain why a saturated solution of $\text{Mg(OH)}_2$ **cannot** be used to test for $\text{CO}_2$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe and explain the trend in the thermal stabilities of the carbonates down Group 2.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Use the *Data Booklet* to explain whether $\text{NiCO}_3$ will decompose more or less readily than $\text{CaCO}_3$.
